title: PhantomReward
description: Unlock /phantoms after Two Birds, One Arrow and let players disable phantoms only for themselves.
body:
# PhantomReward

PhantomReward is a lightweight Paper plugin that unlocks the `/phantoms` command only after a player completes the **Two Birds, One Arrow** advancement.

Once unlocked, each player can toggle phantoms for themselves. When enabled, phantoms will stop targeting, damaging, and bothering that player while still allowing phantoms to exist for others.

## Features

- Unlock `/phantoms` through the vanilla **Two Birds, One Arrow** advancement
- Per-player phantom toggle
- Automatically disables the toggle if the player loses the advancement
- Prevents phantoms from targeting or damaging protected players
- Clears nearby phantoms targeting the player when they toggle protection on
- Simple configuration file
- Lightweight and made for Paper servers

## Commands

- `/phantoms` - Toggle personal phantom protection
- `/phantoms reload` - Reload the plugin configuration

## Permissions

- `phantomreward.use` - Allows players to use `/phantoms`
- `phantomreward.admin` - Allows admins to use `/phantoms reload`

## Requirements

- Paper server
- Java 21
- Minecraft/Paper 26.1.2 tested

## Notes

This plugin is built for Paper. It may also work on Paper forks such as Purpur, but they are not officially tested.
